text:
Peverell Semiconductors has laid off 1,200 staff, about 18% of its 6,700-person global workforce.

Chief Executive Officer Marguerite Oyelaran-Finch confirmed the cuts on 14 March 2025. The company set out the restructuring in a Form 8-K filed the same day, and she discussed it on an investor call she hosted.

On those figures, Peverell is left with roughly 5,500 employees.

**What it means for the sector:** A reduction of nearly one-fifth is a deep cut, not a trim at the edges. It signals a company resetting its cost base. Competitors, suppliers and investors will be reading the filing closely for signs of where Peverell plans to concentrate its resources next.
